candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly in response to terms related to human sexuality, eroticism, and social or psychological concepts.
This feature vector represents sexually explicit content, adult entertainment, and pornography.
This vector represents virtual reality technology, immersive gaming, and spatial computing experiences.
This vector represents digital technology and electronic media.
This feature vector represents concepts related to economics, finance, and commerce.
This vector represents strings containing the letters "iv" or the Roman numeral IV.
This vector activates for word roots and inflections related to the Latin root for "making" or "folding" (such as *facere* and *plicare*).
This vector represents words related to media streaming, digital content consumption, and online browsing or visits.
This vector activates on words, roots, or sub-word tokens containing variations of the Latin root "-press-" or "-ress-".
These tokens represent common Italian noun suffixes, grammatical endings, and morphological roots.
